description: HTTP request sent from the browser, with the logged-in user's cookies: fetches what a server-side request gets a login page for (invoices, authenticated JSON, exports). Text bodies inline (capped by max_length); save_to writes the bytes — the way to read a PDF, since read_page returns nothing on a PDF tab.

max_length.description: Max chars of body returned inline

method.description: HEAD fetches headers only, without the body

save_to.description: Absolute path: write the response bytes here instead of returning them (PDF, images, archives)

url.description: Absolute URL. Cookies are sent for its origin

name: http_request
